bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/gaybbs-menu-20261115"
EXPECTED="1c82a37671737af34b6db5cb960915868f876dc0"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115 >/dev/null
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
docker compose -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -p deploy config -q
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-menu-20261115
ok=0
restore(){
 if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
  docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-menu-20261115 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || true
  docker compose -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || true
 fi
}
trap restore EXIT
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
docker compose -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
for n in $(seq 1 16); do
 if [ "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true ] &&
    docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -c 'test -s /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "クリエイター投稿" /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "🔗ボタン生成" /app/gaybbs.mjs'; then
    ok=1
    break
 fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ok" -eq 1
trap - EXIT
printf 'GAYBBS_MENU_DEPLOY=PASS\nSOURCE_SHA=%s\nCONTAINER=RUNNING\n' "$EXPECTED"
